requirement.value: Cartomancer or Arcanist mastery + Magic Cards SL3

system.description: After discarding via Magic Cards, if the set held a joker: shuffle any non-joker discards back into the deck. Adds the Forbidden Monarch set — four of a kind plus a joker: 777 damage to every enemy you can see, light if the value is even, dark if odd. The joker-in-discard Immunity/Resistance bypass is struck per the standing rule; the 777 stays (ruled: the epic draw is a hype moment).
